sam: Quick heads-up — need 2x LGTM for PR #1289 (kv-cache warmup fix) before cutoff at 11:30 PT. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/core/pull/1289. This blocks the midnight canary. Can people eyeball? cc @cheng @maria

alex: On it, running quick smoke on staging.

alex: smoke logs: `pytest tests/smoke/test_kv_warmup.py -q` -> all green locally. No OOMs.

maria: i'll take a look at the test diff. any nonfunctional changes we should be aware of?

cheng: grabbing perf numbers now, give me 15. If perf delta > 2% we might need a quant-profile tweak.

taylor: quick read — LGTM for code and tests, but please add a tiny comment on the cache TTL var for clarity. Otherwise :thumbsup:

sam: need one more LGTM to hit 2x before 11:30. @alex / @cheng? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

alex: happy to add the comment and give final LGTM. doing it now.

alex: pushed commit to the PR with the comment. LGTM. :white_check_mark:

qa-bot: smoke run on staging passed: green. Noted one intermittent test flake (test_reload), retried and passed.

deploy-bot: Reminder: Cutoff pipeline scheduled at 11:30 PT. If PR lacks 2x LGTM by 11:30 PT, automatic fallback to previous model and rollout paused. See: /workflows/cutoff

sam: Perfect — merging once GH shows 2x LGTM, will kick the canary. Thanks all. If anything fails we abort and escalate in #eng-oncall.
